With over 600 million people projected to live in vulnerable coastal areas by 2050 and #SIDS 🏝️already facing $153 billion in losses from extreme weather over the last 50 years, the urgency for action is clear. Island nations are not just on the front lines—they are at the forefront of solutions, but supporting their leadership is crucial. 💡🌊

On the sidelines of #COP29, I participated in a seminar focused on building global climate governance through zero-carbon island cooperation. Opened by an insightful keynote speech from Mr. Zheng Deyan, Mayor of Yantai City, the event set the stage for discussing community-led energy models and regional partnerships tailored to island contexts. 

I highlighted the value of scalable, community-centered energy hubs that integrate renewable power with key sectors like sustainable fisheries and tourism. I further emphasized on the critical role of adaptive regulatory frameworks for enabling island states to scale renewable energy projects, align with global climate goals, and enhance economic resilience. ☀️

With the right tools and support, island communities can unlock the power of the energy transition and transform their local leadership into a global model for sustainable progress.

#RisingUpForSIDS🏝️ #SustainableEnergyRevolution⚡️ #EnergyForDevelopment #EnergyTransition
